newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sui Chong Holdings mulls asset purchase.
newsitem.headline: Sui Chong Holdings mulls asset purchase.

text.p: Construction and property firm Sui Chong Holdings Ltd said on Friday it was in talks to buy properties from an independent third party.
"Negotiations are at a preliminary stage and the transactions may or may not materialise," the company said in a statement at the request of Hong Kong stock exchange.
"Further announcements on the progress of such negotiations will be made as and when appropriate," it said.
Sui Chong said it was not aware of any negotiations or agreements in relation to a general offer or the injection of infrastructure projects.
Sui Chong shares fell HK$0.11 to HK$0.86 after trading in the company resumed on Friday.
Trading of its shares had been suspended for one day on Thursday at the exchange's directive.
Sui Chong is a subsidiary of Winfoong Investment Ltd.
